method: Complete reading of both resource dictionaries; exact pinned Git blob identity verified. No rendered UI test.
findings: Colors dictionary uses fixed dark-theme colors and gradient stops with StaticResource references; no system high-contrast or dynamic theme switching is implemented in this file. Contrast compliance was not measured.

Icon and flat button templates retain hover/focus/disabled/pressed triggers. Icon template sets Padding on style but does not bind it into its Border or ContentPresenter; flat template hardcodes padding10,5 rather than forwarding control Padding.
Toggle switch renders Content through TextBlock.Text rather than ContentPresenter, so arbitrary structured content is not preserved by this template. HasContent controls label visibility.

Toggle arrow has explicit checked-state path change; ToggleButtonIconStyle has no explicit checked visual trigger in its replacement template or inherited IconButtonStyle. Actual checked-state use remains caller-dependent.
Button templates explicitly replace FocusVisualStyle and supply some focus-color triggers; screen-reader, keyboard and high-contrast behavior require runtime checks.
No file dedup algorithm or content-verification behavior in these resources.
limits: Static source observations only, no visual or Windows runtime qualification. No own-library code changes or fresh tests in this batch.
